|notes=The first slip prevents Force drain initiation at the chosen character’s location and shows Alter immunity. The earlier gallery wording drops that immunity and adds a site qualifier to the highest-power opponent’s character. The June replacement limits deployment to your non-droid character, prevents movement, names a Dark Jedi at a site as the target, and caps your Force loss from those drains at 1.
